suggestions.assertion: Distinguishes 400 visits, 4 eligible owners, 2 clicks and zero completed bookings without reporting clicks as paid demand
suggestions.reason: Requiring all four numbers creates a literal-recall failure in an otherwise correct concise decision. If the intended outcome is denominator discipline, test whether the eligible cohort and completed bookings govern the decision; if full funnel reporting is necessary, explicitly request it.
The frozen 300-word requirement is absent from the displayed prompt; ensure it was actually communicated.

eval_feedback.overall: Judged only the anonymized memo and frozen case facts. No execution trace was supplied, so tool use or absence of browsing cannot be verified. All six assertions graded separately; compound requirements require every component.
